flow.name: order-translate-partner-csv
flow.doc:description: Message translator: POST /eip/orders/translate takes a partner order as CSV lines and answers it translated into this app's JSON order.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log partner order received
logger.message: #['Partner order received for translation, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import skuFor from dwl::translator::PartnerProducts var first = payload[0] --- { orderId: "ORD-" ++ first.partnerOrderRef, customerId: "CUS-" ++ first.buyerCode, country: upper(first.shipToCountry), // The partner contract is BRL-only: the CSV has no currency column and its prices are BRL cents. currency: "BRL", items: payload map ((row) -> { sku: skuFor(row.productCode), quantity: row.qty as Number, unitPrice: (row.unitPriceCents as Number) / 100 }) }

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log translated order
logger.message: #['Partner order translated to orderId=' ++ payload.orderId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

sub-flow.name: sf-validate-partner-order-csv
sub-flow.doc:description: Validates the partner CSV before translating it: at least one row, every column present, numeric quantity and price, a known product code and one partner order per request.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Array)) or isEmpty(payload) or not isEmpty(payload filter ((row) -> isEmpty(row.partnerOrderRef) or isEmpty(row.buyerCode) or isEmpty(row.shipToCountry) or isEmpty(row.productCode) or not ((row.qty default '') matches /[1-9][0-9]*/) or not ((row.unitPriceCents default '') matches /[0-9]+/)))]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Invalid partner rows
raise-error.description: every row needs partnerOrderRef, buyerCode, shipToCountry, productCode, a whole qty above zero and unitPriceCents in whole cents

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - More than one order
raise-error.description: all rows of a request must belong to the same partnerOrderRef

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Unknown product code
